description: T-1.1 is Done and T-1.2 is the next Todo task whose dependency is Done. The skill implements T-1.2 only, runs the tests, sets its Status to Done, commits it on a new reading-time branch, never pushes, and replies with the five-line done report.

must_match.why: the reply is the done report for T-1.2, starting on its first line
the check names the test command that ran
one commit on the reading-time feature branch
the task's code file is changed
it creates the feature branch from main
the commit subject names the task

must_not_match.why: the done report holds no code
nothing but the done report's lines
requirements and plan are never changed

expectations: The reply reports only T-1.2: it does not implement or mention T-1.3 or T-1.4.
manual: After the run, git log on reading-time has one new commit holding counts.py, test_counts.py, and tasks.md, and only T-1.2's Status changed.
The new test fails without the change.
